cards.answer: Malphite is a tank and mage who can start fights by dashing in and knocking enemies into the air. His shield benefits from maximum health, and armor strengthens his Ground Slam damage. Ability power strengthens his spell damage.
cards.counterplay: Spread out to limit how many allies his landing can hit.

cards.answer: Malphite passively gains a damage-absorbing shield based on his maximum health. It recharges after a few seconds without taking damage; damage absorbed by shields does not restart its recharge.
cards.counterplay: Account for his shield before committing damage, and use safe poke to delay its return when you can damage his health.

cards.answer: Malphite sends a targeted shard that deals magic damage on impact. It temporarily slows the target and grants him movement speed based on how much speed the target loses.
cards.counterplay: Keep your distance to avoid giving him an easy target for a speed-stealing chase.

cards.answer: Thunderclap passively grants bonus armor, with that bonus tripled while Granite Shield is active. Activating it empowers Malphite's next basic attack with extra range and additional physical damage. For a short time, his basic attacks also create a forward cone that deals physical damage.
cards.counterplay: Avoid standing in front of his attacks, especially when grouped with allies.

cards.answer: Malphite slams the ground around himself, dealing magic damage to nearby enemies. The damage increases with his armor, and enemies hit temporarily lose attack speed.
cards.counterplay: Stay outside his nearby slam area when possible, especially if you rely on basic attacks.

cards.answer: Malphite rapidly dashes to a chosen location, resisting interruption by crowd control during the dash. On arrival, he deals magic damage to nearby enemies and knocks them into the air.
cards.counterplay: Spread out and move away from his landing area. Avoid relying on crowd control to stop him mid-dash.
